title: THE VERSION RESTARTS AT V0.0001
why: His answer of 2026-10-12: the version players see restarts at v0.0001. The title and the corner label now count from this build as v0.0001, one step per build after it. The internal build number (used by the tools, the party link and the crash records) is unchanged, so nothing that compares versions breaks; the run report shows both numbers, and a copy too old to link is still told its own number.
now: The version shown to players restarts at v0.0001.
